purpose: Primary evidence informing a prospective plan; none is proof of benefit for current generated molecules.

sources.title: FLOWR.root: A flow matching based foundation model for joint multi-purpose structure-aware 3D ligand generation and affinity prediction
sources.supports: Pocket-conditioned joint molecular generation and affinity prediction; importance sampling as a separate population operation.
sources.transfer_limit: Current local checkpoint and archived protocol remain fixed; current article defaults do not silently replace them. The reproduced selection window is not asserted to be the published CK2 exact schedule.

sources.title: On the Guidance of Flow Matching
sources.supports: Guidance depends on flow path and coupling; distinguishes exact constructions and approximate gradient methods.
sources.transfer_limit: Does not prove that the proposed local coordinate potential exactly simulates FLOWR population resampling.

sources.title: PLIP: fully automated protein-ligand interaction profiler
sources.supports: Chemical characterization before geometric interaction matching; redundancy filtering and machine-readable local interaction reports.
sources.transfer_limit: Rule-based detections require structural preparation and are neither differentiable forces nor binding free energies.

sources.title: ProLIF: a library to encode molecular interactions as fingerprints
sources.supports: SMARTS-defined chemical moieties and configurable interaction fingerprints support local pattern comparisons.
sources.transfer_limit: Intended for interpretable molecular structures; early noisy flow states may not have trustworthy graph roles.

sources.title: Identifying Interactions that Determine Fragment Binding at Protein Hotspots
sources.supports: Probe-based fragment hotspot maps identify spatially localized interaction opportunities and were compared with fragment/lead binding positions.
sources.transfer_limit: A generic Gaussian pocket field is not an executed hotspot-map calculation or an energy estimate.

sources.title: Unprecedented selectivity and structural determinants of a new class of protein kinase CK2 inhibitors in clinical trials for the treatment of cancer
sources.supports: CK2 inhibitor scaffolds combine hydrophobic cavity contacts with polar-group and conserved-water interactions.
sources.transfer_limit: Target/scaffold/pose-specific; a downloaded reference structure requires alignment and state checks. Biochemical Ki and the current predicted pIC50 are different endpoints.

sources.title: Potent and Selective Inhibitors of CK2 Kinase Identified through Structure-Guided Hybridization
sources.supports: Structure-guided local scaffold/functional-group combinations provide examples of distinct chemically coherent CK2 binding hypotheses, including water-associated polar context.
sources.transfer_limit: Does not imply every generated seed should carry the same groups or retain a specific water network.

sources.title: Aromatic interactions with heterocycles in water
sources.supports: Experimental dissection links heteroaromatic interaction gains to polar-site hydration and nonpolar desolvation context.
sources.transfer_limit: Supramolecular host-guest system, not direct CK2 SAR; supports a competing explanation, not a numerical reward parameter.

sources.title: Rigorous Free Energy Perturbation Approach to Estimating Relative Binding Affinities between Ligands with Multiple Protonation and Tautomeric States
sources.supports: Protonation and tautomeric equilibria require explicit treatment when estimating binding affinity.
sources.transfer_limit: KSP and Factor Xa examples; formal-charge head expectations alone do not implement that thermodynamic treatment.

sources.title: Kinase inhibitors can change protonation or tautomeric state upon binding
sources.supports: An ensemble computational kinase study reports complex-dependent ligand microstate preferences.
sources.transfer_limit: Preprint; studied kinases do not establish the present CK2 generated-molecule microstates. No numerical result is imported into current reward scales.

sources.title: Assessing interaction recovery of predicted protein-ligand poses
sources.supports: Pose evaluation should inspect recovered interaction patterns as well as geometry similarity.
sources.transfer_limit: A reference interaction fingerprint is an evaluation/analysis aid, not proof of affinity or a requirement to copy the full reference ligand.
